name: filesystem
summary: Read, search and edit files under one folder you choose (official MCP reference server, local stdio)

dir.prompt: The one folder this server may read and write

connect.description: Local filesystem access limited to one folder (stdio, npx)

notes: You are granting access to EVERYTHING under the folder you give: every file and subfolder can be read, overwritten, edited and moved. Choose the narrowest folder that does the job.
write_file overwrites existing files and move_file removes its source; these and the other changing tools are set to ask first (consent).
The server also supports MCP roots; when a client supplies roots they replace the folder given here.
Runs on your machine via npx and needs Node.js. The version is pinned; update it deliberately.
